name: Morning Stretch Routine
description: A gentle full-body stretch to wake up your muscles and ease into the day.

name: Gratitude Journaling
description: Write down three things you're grateful for to start the day with a positive mindset.

name: Box Breathing
description: Breathe in, hold, out, and hold again for 4 counts each to calm your nervous system.

name: Evening Wind-Down
description: Dim the lights, put devices away, and ease your body into rest mode before bed.

name: Deep Work Block
description: A single-task, notification-free block of focused work on your most important task.

name: Inbox Zero Sprint
description: Clear, archive, or respond to every item in your inbox in one focused sprint.

name: Pomodoro Study Session
description: 25 minutes of focused study or work followed by a short break.

name: Weekly Planning Session
description: Map out your top priorities and schedule for the week ahead.

name: Bodyweight Circuit
description: Push-ups, squats, and planks in rotating sets — no equipment needed.

name: Brisk Walk
description: A brisk outdoor or treadmill walk to get your heart rate up.

name: Stair Climb Intervals
description: Alternate fast and slow stair climbs to build cardio endurance.

name: Mobility & Core
description: A short core and mobility routine to support posture and flexibility.

name: Guided Meditation
description: A short guided session to quiet the mind and reset your focus.

name: Visualize Your Goals
description: Picture yourself completing a goal in vivid detail to build motivation.

name: Digital Detox Hour
description: One full hour away from screens to reset your attention span.

name: Affirmation Practice
description: Speak or write a few affirmations that reflect who you're becoming.

name: Read 20 Pages
description: Make steady progress on a book that's teaching you something new.

name: Learn a New Word
description: Pick up a new vocabulary word in a language you're learning and use it in a sentence.

name: Online Course Module
description: Complete one lesson or module in a course you're working through.

name: Teach What You Learned
description: Explain a recent lesson out loud or in writing to deepen your understanding.
